definitions.explanation: Camping outdoors, especially in a wilderness or field setting. Has a slightly more rugged or military nuance compared to キャンプ.

examples.japanese: {野営|やえい}{地|ち}を{探|さが}す。
{装備|そうび}を{整|ととの}えて{河原|かわら}で{野営|やえい}した。
examples.english: We prepared our equipment and camped by the riverbank.

notes:
{野営|やえい} means camping outdoors, especially in a rugged or field setting. Composed of {野|や} (field/wild) + {営|えい} (camp/quarters).

COLLOCATIONS:
- {野営|やえい}{地|ち}: campsite
- {野営|やえい}{場|じょう}: camping ground
- {野営|やえい}{訓練|くんれん}: field camping training (military)
- {野営|やえい}する: to camp outdoors

SIMILAR WORDS:
- キャンプ: camping (casual, general-purpose — most common in everyday speech)
- {露営|ろえい}: bivouacking (literary/military, sleeping outdoors without shelter)
- {宿営|しゅくえい}: billeting, encampment (military lodging)

REGISTER:
{野営|やえい} has a more serious, rugged tone compared to the casual loanword キャンプ. It appears more often in scouting, military, and outdoor survival contexts. For recreational camping at a designated campground, キャンプ is more natural.
